description: Edits a contact as the contact card's pencil does: name, phone (with area code), email, company_name, address (keep its zip if it had one), access_notes, special_instructions, has_pets, pet_details, preferred_cleaner, preferences, availability_notes, contact_type. Send only the fields to change; a contact always keeps a name, phone or email. expected (field -> the value you read) refuses the save if someone changed it since (stale_write). A rename reaches the Quo card when the business's write setting allows. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_client
title: Edit a contact
